game_title: Type Sorter – Cinder Cone Camp Rush
game_concept: A arcade set in Mt. Pyre – Cinder Cone Camp, a camp on a cinder slope: the fire warden must handle ash wraiths while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Type Sorter: Sort falling ore chunks into bins labelled int, float, str and bool before they hit the ground.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Cinder Cone Camp: a camp on a cinder slope
core_gameplay_loop: In Cinder Cone Camp, repeat each round: Sort falling ore chunks into bins labelled int, float, str and bool before they hit the ground. Each round, a new ore chunks challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the sorted_ok value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 150 points of ore chunks by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 150, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 4 (applied tier): Type Sorter
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how sorted_ok changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ash wraiths in Cinder Cone Camp.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 150 within 55 seconds.
